rounds.text: The current valuation of Ravi Leela Granites Ltd rests on a volatile foundation that contradicts the company's long-term historical performance. While recent metrics show high returns, the 10-year median return on equity is -3% and the 5-year median is -7% [E25, E26]. This stark contrast suggests that the recent surge in profitability may be an anomaly rather than a sustainable trend, especially when the company is flagged for a low 3-year average return on equity of 13.2% [E59]. Investors are currently paying a premium for this performance, as evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of 3.25x, which sits significantly higher than the sector benchmark of 2.34x [E7]. Furthermore, the company offers no dividend yield to compensate shareholders for these underlying risks [E4]. Conceded: [E1, E8, E9, E13, E28]. The stock is currently trading near the top of its 52-week range, leaving little margin of safety for investors should the recent spike in returns fail to persist [E5].
